chapter: New Orleans roots and Chicago stories
title: Lorenzo Tio, a New Orleans reading band, and Chicago pay
summary: Dominique talks about Tio teaching musicians, his own reading orchestra that played any publisher's music, and well-paid Chicago work in the twenties and thirties.
